name: VeriWorkly Agent Card
description: VeriWorkly is a developer-focused, privacy-first career workspace ecosystem for ATS-friendly resumes, cover letters, and web portfolios. This agent card provides discovery details, API endpoints, capabilities, and machine-readable resources for AI agents.

api.auth_details: Web clients authenticate using Better Auth via Email OTP, establishing a session cookie ('veriworkly-auth.session_token' in development or '__Secure-veriworkly-auth.session_token' in production). Programmatic agents must use API Keys as Bearer tokens ('Authorization: Bearer vw_...').

services.name: Main Site
services.description: Marketing hub, ATS scanner, pricing, style guide, public roadmap, template gallery, and comparison engine.

services.name: Resume & Document Studio
services.description: Interactive local-first workspace for building, tailoring, and exporting resumes, cover letters, and Master Profile.

services.name: Portfolio Builder & Publishing
services.description: Web portfolio builder, template catalog (Signal, Atelier, Nimbus, Cipher), subdomain publishing (*.veriworkly.com), and view analytics.

services.name: Documentation
services.description: Comprehensive technical guides, integration tutorials, and interactive API reference.

services.name: Blog
services.description: Articles on career engineering, product updates, and open-source architecture.

services.name: API Service
services.description: Node/Express backend service for auth, document sync, ATS scanning, AI tailoring, portfolios, and billing.

capabilities.name: Manage Documents
capabilities.description: Create, read, update, list, and soft-delete resume and cover letter documents.

capabilities.name: Master Profile Store
capabilities.description: Access and update the central canonical career profile used to seed new documents and portfolios.

capabilities.name: ATS Resume Checker
capabilities.description: Deterministic ATS readiness scanning and job-description keyword match analysis.

capabilities.name: AI Content Generation & Tailoring
capabilities.description: AI-powered resume tailoring, section rewriting, bullet point generation, and cover letter drafting.

capabilities.name: Profile Import & Ingestion
capabilities.description: OAuth-based GitHub profile/repo import and AI-parsed LinkedIn exported profile text extraction.

capabilities.name: Portfolio Builder & Subdomain Publishing
capabilities.description: Manage portfolio drafts, check subdomain availability, publish to custom subdomains, and inspect view analytics.

capabilities.name: Public Document Sharing
capabilities.description: Generate, configure password protection, and revoke secure share links for documents.

capabilities.name: Developer API Keys
capabilities.description: Create, list, scope, rotate, and revoke programmatic access tokens.

capabilities.name: Billing & AI Credit Wallet
capabilities.description: Inspect credit wallet balance, manage subscriptions, and initiate Dodo Payments checkout sessions.

capabilities.name: Affiliate & Ambassador Programs
capabilities.description: Track referral links, affiliate commissions, and student ambassador applications.

capabilities.name: Public Roadmap & System Stats
capabilities.description: Access open feature roadmap, GitHub statistics, and health metrics.

compliance.data_storage: Local-first by default (in-browser localStorage), optional cloud sync to encrypted PostgreSQL database.
compliance.ai_privacy: Stateless AI processing. User data is processed strictly on demand and never used to train global AI models.
